description: Unit test class for the TestConnection class in the org.eclipse.ditto.signals.commands.connectivity.modify package. It verifies behaviors such as equality, immutability, JSON serialization/deserialization, and resource path correctness.

classes.name: TestConnectionTest
classes.description: JUnit test class testing the behavior of the TestConnection class in various scenarios, including equality, immutability, JSON conversion, and resource path.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies that the TestConnection class correctly implements hashCode() and equals() methods consistent with the class contract.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Checks that instances of TestConnection are immutable, following the specified mutability constraints.

methods.name: createInstanceWithNullConnection
methods.description: Ensures that passing null to the static factory method of TestConnection throws a NullPointerException with the expected message.

methods.name: fromJsonReturnsExpected
methods.description: Tests that the fromJson method correctly parses a known JSON object into a TestConnection instance.

methods.name: toJsonReturnsExpected
methods.description: Checks that the TestConnection instance correctly serializes back into the expected JSON object.

methods.name: getResourcePathReturnsExpected
methods.description: Verifies that the getResourcePath method returns the correct JsonPointer object.
